subject: Throw a useful error when underlying operations failed with tls (#2469)
reason: The change only alters connTLSGetLastError in src/tls.c to return strerror(last_errno) instead of NULL when no SSL error string is stored. The function is the TLS connection type's get_last_error implementation, reachable only over TLS connections, and every caller uses the result solely to format a server log line or an error string for logging; no caller branches on NULL, so there is no change to replies, data, replication, or persistence — only to log-message wording. The fuzzer cannot exercise it: the catalog has no TLS components, the deployment provider rejects tls-port in any server_con
